data.narrative:
Bedrock Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Joselyn Lai, Silviu Livescu, and Joel Wishkovsky that has raised $15M+. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though no same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with sufficient data density exist for statistical triangulation.

Given data constraints, the Stage-Progression method is the only applicable approach. Using total capital raised ($15M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier yields an implied value of $30M. This method assumes that post-Series A valuations in the sector follow standard progression patterns, though frontier-tech companies in climate can exhibit wider variance than mature verticals.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, centered at $30M. The width of this range reflects substantial methodological uncertainty: the absence of narrow-set peer comparables prevents revenue or growth rate triangulation, and early-stage climate companies often exhibit heterogeneous capital efficiency and path-to-revenue timelines. Key unknowns affecting valuation include the maturity of Bedrock's technology, burn rate relative to deployment potential, and regulatory or commodity price exposure. Any financing round should be informed by operational metrics and technical de-risking alongside this structural analysis.
